P01.rationale: No human portrait or founder image appears anywhere on the page; it is entirely text and step cards.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections or client portraits present on this page.

P07.rationale: No press logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonials are present; the page is purely a methodology framework.

P10.rationale: The '30-50%' stat is displayed at a large size in a boxed callout, but there are no giant ghost numerals or oversized decorative quote glyphs as compositional devices.

P11.rationale: The '30-50% Effizienzgewinn' callout box references a data point, but there are no charts, before/after visuals, or cost-math diagrams — just a single numeric claim in a box.

P12.rationale: The page is reasonably well-filled with a two-column grid of six step cards and a body text block, though the lower portion feels slightly under-utilised compared to a truly dense editorial layout.

P13.rationale: A subtle warm off-white/cream paper texture is used as the background, providing a mild atmospheric quality rather than flat white, but it is very understated.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photograph is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The page contains no photography at all, so stock-image genericness is not an issue, though the step-card layout is a fairly generic consulting template.

N08.rationale: The bottom quarter of the page is largely empty after the six step cards end, leaving a noticeable dead-space region below the content.

N10.rationale: There is no photography on the page, so text-over-busy-photo or awkward inset gap issues do not arise.
